$comment: Native OBWP configured commands. Rust and TypeScript validate correlation, semantic selections, unique catalog IDs and the 256 KiB envelope; JSON Schema closes shapes.

oneOf.$comment: Endpoints are at most 4095 rows apart; native capture fences revision and limits selected text to 8192 UTF-8 bytes.

popupEnvironment.$comment: Rust and TypeScript additionally enforce ASCII-case-unique names and 1024 combined UTF-8 name/value bytes.

popupDirectoryPath.title: WorkbenchDirectoryPath
popupDirectoryPath.$comment: The independent bindings additionally enforce the 4096-byte UTF-8 limit.

popupSpec.$comment: Rust and TypeScript additionally require context.tabId and focusedPaneId to equal the source Tab and Panel, and enforce aggregate context/environment UTF-8 budgets.

wc_terminalGeometry.$comment: Semantic validation additionally requires columns * rows <= 262144, columns * cellPixelWidth <= 65535, and rows * cellPixelHeight <= 65535. The cellPixelWidth/cellPixelHeight pair must be either both positive (pixels known) or both zero (pixels unknown); a mixed pair is invalid.
